children: Sportradar repurchased $157 million of shares in Q3. By Oct. 30, buybacks totaled $519 million since the program began, including $408 million in 2026. The company held €190 million cash and no debt.
Sportradar (SRAD) said third-quarter Betting Technology & Solutions revenue rose 27%, driven partly by content growth and customer uptake. U.S. revenue climbed 47% year over year.
Sportradar (SRAD) said prediction markets boosted third-quarter results for the first time, supported by deals with Polymarket, Kalshi, Novig and Robinhood, plus about 10 market makers.
Sportradar (SRAD) said revenue synergies from IMG ARENA assets beat its 25% target one year after the deal. It expects two $50 million payments from IMG, in Q4 2026 and November 2027.
Sportradar Group AG Class A (SRAD) reaffirmed its 2026 guidance, while citing uncertainty in Brazil and the possibility of an MLB lockout as risks.
Sportradar (SRAD) extended its exclusive global distribution of EuroLeague Basketball data and audiovisual betting rights through 2031, covering more than 650 annual EuroLeague and BKT EuroCup games.
Sportradar kept its full-year outlook, estimating Brazil revenue at just over €60 million. If its Brazil business changes, it may cut office, staffing and sports-rights costs in 2027.
Sportradar’s free cash flow rose 18% to €177 million in the first nine months of 2026. It expects negative Q4 cash conversion but full-year conversion above 2025’s 56%, excluding legal payments.
